description: Makes a person with what is known — a `tag` for their role in the owner's finances (family, household help, landlord — the library's member tags first) and an `email`. A name another person already wears is refused rather than doubled; update_member changes one that exists. Writes are schema-validated and provenance-stamped, and land in the app's Changes screen where the owner keeps or undoes the whole batch. Card numbers, CVVs and credentials are refused by the validator, which names the row. `source` ("documents/hdfc-2026.pdf", "gmail:18c2…") records where a row came from in the diff.

email.description: Where a shared report reaches them.

name.description: The name, as the owner said it. Refused when another person already wears it.

tag.description: Their role in the owner's finances — a member tag: family, household help, landlord.

name: add_member
title: Add a person
